dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: This is Gentry Maocai's residence. He's a big trader in the gem industry.

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: Though apparently not long ago there was a leak in some sensitive business information, and as a result he ended up getting overcharged by someone from the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: Who could be so careless as to let out such influential information?
